turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
I will show you one example first.
"She is eating an apple." I look at the word apple. It starts with the sound "a", which is a vowel sound. So I write an.
Rule: an comes before a vowel sound; a comes before other sounds.
Right: We have a dog at home. Wrong: We have an dog at home.

Your turn now. Write a or an:
She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
